title: Professor of Education Professor of Pediatrics Professor in the Department of Social and Behavioral Sciences Professor of Psychology in the Department of Psychiatry
bio: Charles Nelson's research includes developmental cognitive neuroscience, early experience on brain and behavioral development, and the effects of early biological insults and psychosocial adversity among typical children as well those at risk for neurodevelopmental disorders, including autism.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
